name: n4_histories_audit
description: Audit the histories of the connected station below base, in one read-only call (station-audits S1). It lists: no_history, the control points with no history extension right below them ({point}), leaving out the points under slot:/Services unless exclude_services is false (services_excluded counts them); disabled, the history extensions whose enabled is false ({ext, history_id}); stale, the enabled histories whose last record is older than the larger of stale_factor x the collection interval and stale_min (interval histories; stale_min, default 10m, keeps short-interval histories whose records show up in batches from false positives) or than cov_max_age (COV histories), or that never recorded ({history_id, ext, last_record ISO-8601 or null, interval as a span such as 5m or cov, threshold, age, note}); near_capacity, the histories capped by record count holding at least capacity_warn of it ({history_id, ext, records, capacity, fraction, full_policy, severity, effect}: severity warning for full policy stop, where recording stops when full, info for roll, where the oldest records are overwritten); and colliding_ids, the history ids two or more extensions record into ({history_id, exts}). Each list keeps at most 100 items; counts holds the totals (points, history_exts and one per list). It reads select slotPath, type, enabled, historyConfig.id, historyConfig.capacity, fullPolicy, interval and lastRecord.timestamp (each as encodeToString) from history:HistoryExt (at most max_histories rows) and select slotPath from control:ControlPoint, then one select count(*) per distinct record-capped history id that has recorded (count_reads; requests is the total, elapsed_ms the time); the count reads, and the flat reads, run four at a time, and every list keeps the order of the extensions read. truncated is true when a read stopped at its cap: then no_history is not checked (counts.no_history null, no_history_note says why). not_answered counts cells the station answered in no known form, per column; notes say what was left out. flat=true (off by default) adds flat, the histories holding one value for more than flat_days days (default 2), each a possible device placeholder such as a device sending 0.0 for no sensor ({history_id, ext, point, value as the station renders it, window_start, note}): for each distinct enabled history that has recorded within the window, one read of select min(value), max(value) where status.null = false over [now - flat_days, now] and, when min equals max, one select count(*) before the window (a history younger than the window is never flat); a history with no record in the window is left to stale; counts.flat, flat_days and flat_reads are added, and a failed flat read is a note. Read-only: fixed queries. flat_scope=sensors (default all, the behaviour above) keeps only sensor readings in flat: histories collected at an interval, and COV histories of a point whose units are a temperature, humidity, pressure, flow, ppm or lux unit; settings and enums (Mode, Occupancy, Power) that hold one value are left out and not read. flat_down=true (off by default) lists a flat history whose point status has down, stale or fault set in flat_down ({history_id, ext, point, value, status, window_start, note}: the device is down, not a placeholder) instead of flat. Either option adds one read of select slotPath, status.bits, facets from control:ControlPoint (counted in flat_reads); when it fails, flat keeps every history and a note says so. counts.flat_down is added with flat_down, flat_scope is echoed when it is sensors.

base.description: Slot ORD of the folder to audit, itself and below, e.g. station:|slot:/Drivers (default: the whole station)

exclude_services.description: Leave the control points under slot:/Services out of no_history

stale_factor.description: An interval history is stale when its last record is older than this many collection intervals

stale_min.description: Least age before an interval history is stale, whatever its interval: 30s, 10m, 1h (the threshold is the larger of stale_factor x interval and this)

cov_max_age.description: A COV history is stale when its last record is older than this span: 30m, 24h, 7d

capacity_warn.description: Fraction of a record-count capacity from which a history is near capacity

max_histories.description: Most history extensions read (and record counts read)

flat.description: true adds flat: the histories holding one value for more than flat_days days, each a possible device placeholder (e.g. 0.0 sent for no sensor), with its point and value

flat_days.description: Days one value must hold before flat lists a history (with flat=true)

flat_scope.description: With flat=true: all lists every flat history; sensors only interval histories and COV histories of a temperature, humidity, pressure, flow, ppm or lux point

flat_down.description: With flat=true: a flat history whose point is down, stale or in fault goes to flat_down (device down, not a placeholder), not to flat

timeout_s.description: HTTP timeout per request in seconds
